maya: Quick note from a customer repro: Go SDK generator doesn't cancel promptly if creds block during token refresh. Minimal snippet below.

maya: ```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
creds := &slowCreds{delay: 2 * time.Second}
client := NewClient(WithCredentials(creds))
// cancel shortly after starting
go func() { time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond); cancel() }()
_, err := client.Generator(ctx, "m-small")
if err != nil { log.Printf("err: %v", err) }
```

liam: Reproduced locally. The handshake goroutine blocks inside creds.Fetch with no ctx available.

frank: Short-term fix idea: add client config handshakeTimeout with default 5s so sample apps don't hang.

olga: Long-term: make creds interface accept a context (GetToken(ctx)) + add generator.Close()/Abort() as an explicit cancellation primitive for existing users.

ci-bot: [ci] Canary e2e showing goroutine growth for generator tests. Filing INF-4002.

maya: For DX we should also update the onboarding sample to show `context.WithTimeout` around stream start and a `defer g.Close()` pattern.

liam: I'll open a PR for a small docs change and a unit test that simulates slow creds and asserts no goroutine leaks after cancel.

frank: And I'll add handshakeTimeout config in the client options as a stopgap.

olga: Good. Make sure the CHANGELOG notes the creds API change and migration snippet.
